The kung-fu fighting cook steps in to save an investigative journalist on the run from a gang of murderous drug dealers, resulting in a potentially fatal mix-up involving her incriminating tape of the gangsters and a children's video.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables
sky cinema action.desc: A group of mercenaries is double-crossed during a mission and are approached by Church to overthrow the ruthless dictator of a South American country. It isn't long before the men realise things aren't quite as they appear, finding themselves caught in a dangerous web of betrayal. Although their mission is compromised and an innocent is in danger, soldier of fortune Barney and his comrades decide to get the job done.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables 2
sky cinema action.desc: Mercenary Barney Ross and his team cut a swath of destruction through opposing forces as they take revenge for the vicious murder of a comrade.

sky cinema action.title: The Expendables 3
sky cinema action.desc: After a former associate makes it his mission to end the Expendables, Barney Ross assembles a team of younger recruits to help take down their enemy.

sky cinema family.title: Tim Burton's Corpse Bride
sky cinema family.desc: Anxious not to make a mistake in his wedding ceremony, Victor goes to the woods to practise his vows. Unfortunately, he slides the ring onto the twig-finger of a long-dead bride who has been waiting years for a suitor.

sky cinema family.title: The Boss Baby
sky cinema family.desc: A wildly imaginative seven-year-old boy discovers that his new brother, Boss Baby, is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

sky cinema family.title: Sing
sky cinema family.desc: A pig, a mouse, a porcupine, a gorilla, an elephant and other animals gather at a koala's theatre for a singing competition.

sky cinema family.title: Flushed Away
sky cinema family.desc: A spoiled rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins and make his way back to his plush home.

sky cinema family.title: Kung Fu Panda
sky cinema family.desc: Po might just be the laziest, clumsiest panda in the Valley of Peace, but he secretly dreams of becoming a kung fu legend. When the villainous snow leopard Tai Lung threatens Po's homeland, the hapless panda is chosen to fulfil an ancient prophecy and defend the Valley from attack. Training under Master Shifu, Po embarks on an epic high-kicking adventure as he sets out to thwart Tai Lung's evil plans. A DreamWorks animation.

sky cinema family.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
sky cinema family.desc: Po must unlock secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China. A DreamWorks animation.

sky cinema comedy.title: Twinless
sky cinema comedy.desc: Two men who lost their respective twin brothers develop a growing friendship after meeting in a support group. However, both harbour long-hidden secrets that threaten to tear them apart.

sky cinema comedy.title: Marmaduke
sky cinema comedy.desc: A super-sized Great Dane helps his family adjust to their new lives in California while simultaneously trying to fit in with his new canine pals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu stumble upon a hidden jungle society that hails the panda as a "divine beast." Jackie must face a group of tribal warriors to protect his panda friend and uncover the ancient secrets of the mysterious land.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridesmaids
sky cinema comedy.desc: Though broke and lovelorn, a woman takes on the strange and expensive rituals associated with being her best friend's maid of honour.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: It Feeds
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A clairvoyant therapist confronts her own personal demons while trying to save a young girl who believes a malevolent entity is feeding on her.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Opus
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A young writer travels to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by a cult of sycophants and intoxicated journalists, she soon finds herself in the middle of his twisted plan.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Get Out
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A young photographer uncovers a dark secret when he meets his girlfriend's seemingly friendly parents for the first time at their posh estate.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: As the search to find a rare flower in the jungles of Borneo gets underway, the situation deteriorates rapidly. First infighting amongst the research team breaks out but soon they have a problem which unites them; there is a very large and very hungry snake present.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Innerspace
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. Attempts by his colleagues to retrieve the little man - protected inside a tiny submersible - are hampered by the would-be thieves.

sky cinema thriller.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema thriller.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me
sky cinema thriller.desc: A federal agent and an Interpol detective play a cat-and-mouse game with cunning illusionists who rob corrupt business leaders during their performances, then funnel the money to members of the audience.

sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: A devious tech wizard forces the illusionists known as the Four Horsemen to steal a powerful chip that can control all of the world's computers.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema greats.title: Paulie
sky cinema greats.desc: A wisecracking parrot caged in a research lab tells his life story to a lonely janitor. Before coming to the science lab, he has passed through the hands of a succession of owners, from a petty criminal to a man who runs a parrot-dancing act. Touched by his colourful story, the janitor conspires to liberate the talking bird.

sky cinema greats.title: The Wiz
sky cinema greats.desc: In this version of the classic story - based on the smash Broadway musical - Dorothy is a shy 24-year-old Harlem kindergarten teacher who is brought by a snowstorm to the mysterious Land of Oz, a sprawling, decaying, nightmarish, and dangerous megalopolis that resembles the physical characteristics of New York City.

sky cinema greats.title: The Wizard of Oz
sky cinema greats.desc: Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.

sky cinema greats.title: Hook
sky cinema greats.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

sky cinema greats.title: Jumanji
sky cinema greats.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

sky cinema drama.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
sky cinema drama.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.

sky cinema drama.title: Eleanor the Great
sky cinema drama.desc: After the death of her oldest friend, 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein moves from Florida to New York City for a fresh start. Wandering into a support group for Holocaust survivors, she tells a tale that takes on a dangerous life of its own.

sky cinema drama.title: A Star Is Born
sky cinema drama.desc: Hard-drinking country music star Jackson Maine discovers, and falls in love with, a struggling but talented singer named Ally. As her career quickly takes off, Jackson starts to realize that his best days may be behind him.

sky cinema drama.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
sky cinema drama.desc: Depicts 8-year-old Bobo's life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the Bush War's final stages. It explores the family's bond with Africa's land and the war's impact on the region and individuals through Bobo's perspective.

sky cinema drama.title: Valentine's Day
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a group of Los Angeles' residents who try to find their way through the highs and lows of love during a single day.
